Options:
  --seed  Install seed packages
  --clear  Remove existing environment contents
  --system-site-packages  Expose system packages
  --prompt PROMPT  Set shell prompt text
  --relocatable  Make the environment relocatable
  --allow-existing  Allow an existing directory
  --python PYTHON  Select a Python interpreter
  --offline  Disable network access
  --no-cache  Disable caching
  --directory DIRECTORY  Change working directory
  --project PROJECT  Select project directory
